{{Quote|You see, the asteroid field we've discovered recently is peppered with rocks which we've yet to get near or attain. The Zynt'aia Order has been hounding us ever since they've settled in the Tatoo System, watching our every move. I expected them to try and take over our mining field, just not this soon.|[[A'Lerris Verata]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:TAZO">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|The Awakened: Zynt'aia Order|Tatoo system}}</ref>}}
A '''mining crew''' was active in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="SWG:ET" /> Led by Mining Chief Operator [[A'Lerris Verata]], the miners were in conflict with the [[Zynt'aia Spice Guardians|Zynt'aia pirates]] for the control of the [[Nallera's Mining Field]]<ref name="SWG:TAZO" /> and its valuable [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] of [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]].<ref name="SWG:TWWCR">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|That Word We Call "Revenge"|Tatoo system}}</ref>

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nallera's mining crew appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ET" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nallera's mining crew was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:ET" />
